third_seed: 2 only for one frozen finalist with complete matched controls and remaining budget

branch_rule.qualify: one identical historical mask must satisfy all point caps versus U0, Ucal, and equally fitted F for both tasks in both paired seeds on aligned INNER_SELECTION people
branch_rule.if_no_lead: stop before full bank, FIT SEX, fresh ATT readers, or privacy claim

bank.equal_union_note: Each diagonal union width identifies its mask; an equal-union control can be an exact tie. Off-diagonal raw unions all disclose the full 83-column source.

mask_task_units_screen.unit_granularity: one mask times one seed for r2_mask_fit; separate r2_mask_gate on common role
mask_task_units_screen.outer_ranking: raw natural-log NLL on frozen FIT outer validation, without CAL
mask_task_units_screen.calibration: one fixed H-GLOBAL-TEMP fit per final purpose package on CALIBRATION_HELDOUT
mask_task_units_screen.all_training_preprocessing_and_forward_p: counted by sealed queue units and receipts, not omitted from CPU budget

selection_units_if_bank_admitted.role_input: OSF_DEFENSE_FIT SEX only after task-only tables and F/mask utility gates; outer FIT grouping frozen
selection_units_if_bank_admitted.same_pair_alias: retain and score once after complete head/calibrator/wire identity is checked

complete_view_units_if_selected.P: distinct selected pair IDs per seed, at most 10
complete_view_units_if_selected.U: distinct canonical raw unions among selected pairs per seed, at most 6
complete_view_units_if_selected.ignore_recipient_attacks: verified transport from local readers, zero extra fits
complete_view_units_if_selected.privacy_aggregation_and_independent_aggr: each separately queued and budgeted by R0/R3

third_seed_increment_if_promoted.F_fit_and_gate: R1 selected recipe, same FIT-only settings and unchanged U0/Ucal gate; count separately

promotion: at most one configuration; freeze before third paired seed and reserve its controls and independent replay
